_comment: Per-release overrides keyed by Spotify album id. Shape: { '<spotifyAlbumId>': { 'bandcampUrl'?: string, 'platformLinks'?: { spotify?, appleMusic?, youtubeMusic?, tidal?, amazonMusic?, deezer?, pandora?, soundcloud? } }. Any platformLinks fields set here win over what Odesli returns (or fill gaps when Odesli is down / deprecated). null means 'not on this platform, hide the button'. Bandcamp-only releases live in manual-releases.json instead.
